items.label: Utah income tax
items.note: 4.45% of income, less the taxpayer credit (6% of the federal standard deduction, reduced by 1.3% of income over $18,213, or $36,426 married).

provisional: Taxpayer credit phase-out threshold ($18,213 / $36,426) is the 2025 amount, carried over from 2026 until the 2027 figure is published
